notes.note: Source-impact review: mcp-service.ts refuses an issuer change while a client secret is bound, resets tokens on issuer change, and lets an empty sign-in scope choice drop the integration default; the integration schema accepts oauthClient.issuer (an RFC 8414 HTTPS issuer). Searched this document for MCP tool-server OAuth client, issuer, client secret, secret-binding grant and scope claims; none describes these paths beyond links that still resolve, so its claims stay accurate.
